function swItemIcon(id,large=false){
 const item=SW_ITEM_BY_ID.get(id);if(!item)return '';
 const px=large?64:32;
 return `<span class="sw-item-icon ${large?'sw-large':''}" title="${item.name}" role="img" aria-label="${item.name}" style="background-position:-${item.col*px}px -${item.row*px}px"></span>`;
}
function swDrawGatheredItem(id,x,y,w=52,h=52){
 const item=SW_ITEM_BY_ID.get(id),im=PIXEL_ART.itemAtlas32;
 if(!item||!im?.complete||!im.naturalWidth)return false;
 g.drawImage(im,item.col*32,item.row*32,32,32,Math.round(x-w/2),Math.round(y-h),w,h);return true;
}

function swPaintMonsterCodex(){
 const box=document.getElementById('sw-monster-codex');if(!box||!box.open)return;
 const f=Math.floor(performance.now()/165)%8;
 for(const canvas of box.querySelectorAll('canvas[data-sw-mon]')){
  const m=SW_MONSTER_BY_ID.get(canvas.dataset.swMon);if(!m)continue;
  const im=PIXEL_ART[m.group==='normal'?'monsters':m.group==='elite'?'eliteMonsters':'boss'];
  if(!im?.complete||!im.naturalWidth)continue;
  const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
  ctx.drawImage(im,f*m.frameSize,m.row*m.frameSize,m.frameSize,m.frameSize,0,0,m.frameSize,m.frameSize);
 }
}
function swPaintMonsterWalkCodex(){
 const box=document.getElementById('sw-monster-codex');if(!box||!box.open)return;
 const frame=Math.floor(performance.now()/185)%4;
 for(const canvas of box.querySelectorAll('canvas[data-sw-walk]')){
  const m=SW_MONSTER_BY_ID.get(canvas.dataset.swWalk);if(!m)continue;
  const elite=m.group!=='normal',im=SW_WALK_IMAGES[elite?'elite':'normal'],cell=elite?64:32;
  if(!im?.complete||!im.naturalWidth)continue;
  const row=elite?(['toad','boar','mage','king'].indexOf(m.id)):(['slime','wolf','spider','treant','bat','golem','wraith','sentinel'].indexOf(m.id));
  if(row<0)continue;const c=canvas.getContext('2d');c.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;c.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
  c.drawImage(im,frame*cell,row*cell,cell,cell,0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
 }
}

 document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--sw-atlas32',`url("${ART_DATA.urls.itemAtlas32}")`);
 document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--sw-atlas64',`url("${ART_DATA.urls.itemAtlas64}")`);
 ensurePixelAsset('itemAtlas32');ensurePixelAsset('eliteMonsters');ensurePixelAsset('boss');
 setInterval(()=>{swPaintMonsterCodex();swPaintMonsterWalkCodex();swPaintSkillCodex()},180);
}
